_note: A child route's generated $types.d.ts reaches its parent through a sibling chain: import('../$types.js').RouteParams. The mirror re-anchors that chain onto the parent's MIRRORED copy — the un-mirrored original under .svelte-kit/types/ carries unrewritten chains of its own, so anchoring there pulls the raw user tree back into the program. This fixture locks the two-hop resolution end to end: child $types -> mirrored parent $types -> re-anchored matcher chain -> user matcher. If either hop lands on a wrong path the matched param widens to any and the expected TS2322 vanishes.
